Vendored front-end libraries for the Walk of Fame Globe prototype.

- MapLibre GL JS — BSD 3-Clause. https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js
- three.js — MIT. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- Spark (@sparkjsdev/spark 2.4.0) — MIT. https://github.com/sparkjsdev/spark
  Local copies: spark.module.js and the full MIT text in spark.LICENSE.txt.
- three.js examples add-on `postprocessing/Pass.js` — MIT, from three@0.187.0
  (same revision as vendor/three.module.js and vendor/three.core.js, REVISION 187).
  Local copy: three/addons/postprocessing/Pass.js

- three.js examples add-ons used to load compressed glTF (MIT, three@0.187.0,
  same revision as vendor/three.module.js):
  loaders/GLTFLoader.js, loaders/KTX2Loader.js, utils/SkeletonUtils.js,
  utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js, utils/WorkerPool.js, math/ColorSpaces.js,
  libs/ktx-parse.module.js, libs/zstddec.module.js.
- meshopt_decoder.module.js — MIT, meshoptimizer, Arseny Kapoulkine.
  Local copy: three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js
- Basis Universal transcoder (basis_transcoder.js / .wasm) — Apache License
  2.0, Binomial LLC, as shipped with three@0.187.0.
  Local copies: three/addons/libs/basis/
